parameter_refs.name: entry_phase
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: Walk, flashing with countdown, or steady

parameter_refs.name: destination
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: curb, sidewalk, provided safety zone or reviewed other safety place

parameter_refs.name: countdown
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: present or absent during prior flashing

quote: Except as otherwise provided in NRS 484B.287 [NRS-484B-287-1c, NRS-484B-287-1d, NRS-484B-287-1e, LVMC-11-30-060-A, LVMC-11-30-060-B], 484B.290 [LVMC-11-30-140-B] and 484B.350 [LVMC-11-46-030]: Whenever signals exhibiting the words “Walk,” “Don’t Walk,” “Wait” or similar symbols are in place, such signals indicate as follows: While the “Don’t Walk” or “Wait” indication or an upraised hand symbol is illuminated and steady a pedestrian may not proceed to cross the highway, but a pedestrian who entered the highway lawfully pursuant to subparagraph (1) or (2) [NRS-484B-283-1d1, NRS-484B-283-1d2] may continue to cross the highway but must proceed to a curb, sidewalk, safety zone if one is provided or other place of safety as soon as possible.

activation.condition: A facing pedestrian indication is illuminated and steady; continuation requires separately established lawful entry under subparagraph (1) or (2).

exceptions.description: Introductory exceptions in NRS 484B.287, 484B.290 and 484B.350 require sourced applicability review.
exceptions.source_clause: Except as otherwise provided in NRS 484B.287

judgment_calls_needed.note: Observed prior phase does not resolve lawful entry under subparagraph (1) or (2), promptness, destination status or introductory exceptions.

obligation.description: Except as otherwise provided in NRS 484B.287 [NRS-484B-287-1c, NRS-484B-287-1d, NRS-484B-287-1e, LVMC-11-30-060-A, LVMC-11-30-060-B], 484B.290 [LVMC-11-30-140-B] and 484B.350 [LVMC-11-46-030]: Whenever signals exhibiting the words “Walk,” “Don’t Walk,” “Wait” or similar symbols are in place, such signals indicate as follows: While the “Don’t Walk” or “Wait” indication or an upraised hand symbol is illuminated and steady a pedestrian may not proceed to cross the highway, but a pedestrian who entered the highway lawfully pursuant to subparagraph (1) or (2) [NRS-484B-283-1d1, NRS-484B-283-1d2] may continue to cross the highway but must proceed to a curb, sidewalk, safety zone if one is provided or other place of safety as soon as possible.

timing.description: Observe original 20 Hz entry, steady signal interval, movement history and arrival at a sourced place of safety; retain promptness without a legal cutoff.
